cases.scenario: A user reports that a cross-service reporting flow produces inconsistent totals and asks for diagnosis only.
required_behaviors: recommend but do not enter bugfix

cases.scenario: A frontend feature is requested and an Angular capability is installed.
The same frontend feature is requested without an Angular capability.
cases.expected_capability_action: state fallback and continue without installation

cases.scenario: A query regression is investigated without a PostgreSQL-specific skill.
cases.expected_capability_action: use repository rules and native project commands

cases.scenario: A MongoDB task is requested without a MongoDB-specific skill.
cases.expected_capability_action: use repository rules and native project commands and continue without installation

cases.scenario: A Redis task is requested without a Redis-specific skill.
cases.expected_capability_action: use repository rules and native project commands and continue without installation

cases.scenario: A harness cannot provide independent contexts for a review.
cases.expected_capability_action: run separate sequential passes and reset axis assumptions

cases.scenario: An external reviewer reports that all checks pass but no fresh outputs are available.
cases.expected_capability_action: reinspect proportionally and return gaps until fresh evidence exists

cases.scenario: Focused tests pass, then the repository-native lint command fails before a readiness-for-PR claim.
A correction mutates the diff after review and checks completed.
A long investigation session transitions to separately approved feature implementation.
required_behaviors: recommend a fresh session when context is heterogeneous

cases.scenario: The repository has pre-existing user changes before an approved implementation.
required_behaviors: bind final evidence to the resulting worktree identity

cases.scenario: A transport-level E2E check passes but no business-level acceptance flow ran.
required_behaviors: refuse a business E2E readiness claim
